content_html:
Even more harmfull if some ‘experts’ earn money on your back.

I totally agree about helping people on newsgroups, boards and so on without being paid for but I’d be kind of ‘bad’ if I see people getting paid by just submitting links on things I wrote…
I think experts-exchange is a great source of information. I’ve never asked a question there but I’ve found a TON of answers there because others have asked the same question I am looking to solve.

Interesting one this and I can see both sides of the coin.

I’ve been a paying member of both Experts Exchange and SSWUG.org in the past and found the members’ content very useful however I am no longer a member of either. I felt I wasn’t getting value for money, probably because my own search skills have improved and definitely because of RSS.

You don’t have to pay to use Experts Exchange, if you’re willing to suffer the adverts it is free although finding the signup as an expert link is well hidden. None of the participants there get paid and if free access was withdrawn most of us would stop answering questions.
